description: Open-source protocol for multi-agent workflow orchestration: runs of AI agents, tools and people that stream events, pause for human approval, resume and replay, the same way on any host that implements it, over REST and Server-Sent Events.
rules: OpenWOP is a wire protocol, not a library: talk to a host over REST and SSE; the TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs are thin clients of the same wire surface.
Start every integration by reading GET /.well-known/openwop and only use capabilities the host advertises there; never assume an optional extension is present.
Send the API key and the protocol version header on every v2 call; target spec/v2, not spec/v1.
Stream run events over SSE and resume a dropped stream with Last-Event-ID instead of re-polling or restarting the run.
Human approval is an interrupt: the run suspends in waiting-approval and resumes only when a person answers; do not model it as a sleep or a poll loop.
Replay and fork re-run from a past step with side effects suppressed; give every side-effecting tool call a stable effect identity so retries and replays stay at-most-once.
Credentials are referenced by credentialRef and resolved by the host; never put key material in run options, events or logs.
